entry.name: icon
entry.label: Main Icon

entry.name: iconFallback
entry.label: Main Icon

entry.name: defaultVolume
entry.label: Default volume (0-100)

entry.name: fadeEnabled
entry.label: Smooth fade on station change

entry.name: fadeDuration
entry.label: Fade duration in ms

entry.name: panelShowTrack
entry.label: Show artist and title next to the panel icon

entry.name: panelTextWidth
entry.label: Maximum width of the panel text (grid units)

entry.name: albumArtEnabled
entry.label: Lookup album art online (Deezer, iTunes)

entry.name: blurBackdrop
entry.label: Blurred backdrop in now playing

entry.name: favorites
entry.label: Favorite stations (JSON array of names)

entry.name: mprisEnabled
entry.label: Enable system media keys (MPRIS)

entry.name: autoBitrate
entry.label: Automatically pick highest available bitrate via radio-browser.info

entry.name: syncOffsetMap
entry.label: Per-device lag in ms — Bluetooth keyed by MAC, wired keyed by sink name (JSON)

entry.name: syncSweepBiasMap
entry.label: Per-speaker correction the inaudible sweep measurement has learned about its own systematic error, keyed by Bluetooth MAC (JSON)

entry.name: syncMicName
entry.label: The microphone the last calibration measured as the best ear in this machine — asked for again by name so later checks listen through the same one

entry.name: syncAutoCare
entry.label: Keep the sync tuned automatically: a sweep through each speaker every few minutes, pitched above what most adults hear, and one automatic re-verify when it confirms a drift. Audio is processed in place and never stored or transmitted.

entry.name: syncManualOnly
entry.label: Tune the speakers by ear with the slider only. The microphone is never used: no test tones, no automatic checks, nothing measured.

entry.name: timeshiftEnabled
entry.label: Pause live radio: while a station plays, a background copy is kept on this computer so pausing resumes exactly where the listener left off, behind the broadcast. The buffer is deleted when playback stops.

entry.name: timeshiftWindowMin
entry.label: How many minutes of live radio the pause buffer can hold before it stops growing.

entry.name: syncUltrasonic
entry.label: Measure with an 18-19 kHz sweep instead of an audible click. Most adults cannot hear this range, but younger ears often can, and dogs and cats certainly do — so it can be switched off; measurement then uses the click and needs a quiet room.

entry.name: syncRefLatMap
entry.label: Bluetooth sink's PipeWire-reported latency in ms at calibration time, keyed by MAC (JSON) — the reference the silent recompensation shifts against

entry.name: searchHistory
entry.label: Recent successful web searches, newest first (JSON array)

entry.name: syncEarSetAt
entry.label: When the listener last moved the fine-tune slider (ms since epoch); its ten-minute window must survive a panel restart

entry.name: syncVerifiedMs
entry.label: Residual speaker spread measured by the last verify pass (ms); -1 means never verified

entry.name: deviceTrims
entry.label: Per-device volume balance, 0.05-1.0 of the master level (JSON: device id to factor)

entry.name: deviceChannels
entry.label: Per-speaker channel in the combined output: L, R or M (mono mix); absent means stereo (JSON: device id to mode)

entry.name: syncExcluded
entry.label: Speakers sitting out of the combined output; absent means included (JSON: device id to true)

entry.name: syncOffsetMs
entry.label: Extra latency reported for Bluetooth sinks while the combined output is active (ms)

entry.name: combinePrevOutput
entry.label: Output device chosen before the combined output was enabled — restored when a session ends uncleanly

entry.name: combinePrevDefault
entry.label: System default sink before the combined output took it over — restored when a session ends uncleanly

entry.name: combineMasterPct
entry.label: Combined output master level the room was left at — the next enable's ramp ends here instead of at full passthrough. 0 means never set: the first enable then inherits the level the machine was already playing at, which is the whole point of not blasting a fresh install

entry.name: combineWanted
entry.label: The sync switch as the user left it — a login rebuilds the group instead of silently dropping it

entry.name: autoHeal
entry.label: When a saved station's stream dies, look up its current address on radio-browser.info and follow it

entry.name: autoRetry
entry.label: When a station goes quiet, retry it at widening intervals for a short while. Off: a dead stream stops at once. Either way, once the widget has given up it does not put the station on again by itself. An alarm is never bound by this

entry.name: autoRetryKnocks
entry.label: How many retries a quiet station gets before it is left alone. The intervals widen (30 s, 1 min, 2 min...), so three of them span about three and a half minutes. 0 keeps retrying until the station comes back. An alarm is never bound by this

entry.name: downloadFormat
entry.label: Download format: best (max quality, no re-encode), mp3, opus, mp4 (video)

entry.name: history
entry.label: Recently played tracks (JSON)

entry.name: likedSongs
entry.label: Liked tracks (JSON)

entry.name: podcastSubs
entry.label: Podcast subscriptions (JSON array of {title, author, art, feedUrl})

entry.name: podcastPositions
entry.label: Podcast resume positions (JSON map episode-key to {sec, dur, at})

entry.name: podcastDownloads
entry.label: Downloaded-episode ledger (JSON map filename to {key, title, show, art, feed, at}) — the Downloaded view's join against the folder

entry.name: podcastAutoRefreshHours
entry.label: How often the subscriptions are checked for new episodes, in hours (0 = never)

entry.name: podcastAutoDownload
entry.label: Download the newest episode of a show automatically when the refresh finds one

entry.name: podcastAutoClean
entry.label: Quietly remove PLAYED downloads that are old or past ten per show — unplayed files are never touched

entry.name: podcastContinuous
entry.label: When an episode ends, continue with the show's oldest unheard downloaded episode

entry.name: podcastSkipSilence
entry.label: Jump over stretches of dead air in episodes (per-file silence map, measured at download time)

entry.name: podcastSeen
entry.label: Newest episode key seen per feed (JSON map) — what the refresh compares against

entry.name: podcastUpNext
entry.label: The listener's cross-show Up-next queue (JSON array of episode identities)

entry.name: podcastLastRefresh
entry.label: When the last subscription refresh ran (epoch ms as a string)

entry.name: podcastSpeeds
entry.label: Playback speed per show (JSON map feedUrl to rate; "" key is the default)

entry.name: podcastPlayed
entry.label: Played podcast episodes (JSON map episode-key to timestamp)

entry.name: castMenuHeight
entry.label: Remembered height of the output/volume menu in pixels (0 = auto-fit)

entry.name: historyPanelHeight
entry.label: Remembered height of the recently-played list in pixels (0 = auto)

entry.name: reportClicks
entry.label: Report an anonymous listening click to radio-browser.info when a station starts playing — opt-in: anything leaving the machine is the user's call

entry.name: downloadDir
entry.label: Download directory (empty = ~/Music/OnAir)

entry.name: aiHelperEnabled
entry.label: Clean up track title with Claude CLI before searching/downloading — opt-in: sends track names to an external service

entry.name: accentMode
entry.label: Colours: 0 = the built-in emerald, 1 = the system accent colour, 2 = plain (no colour of its own)

entry.name: followSystemAccent
entry.label: Use the system accent color instead of the built-in emerald theme

entry.name: pin
entry.label: Keep the popup open when focus moves to another window (the header's pin button)

entry.name: showMusicTab
entry.label: Show the My Music tab

entry.name: showPodcastsTab
entry.label: Show the Podcasts tab

entry.name: showTimersTab
entry.label: Show the Timers tab

entry.name: showStationsTab
entry.label: Show the Stations tab (the last remaining tab always stays)

entry.name: showPlayingTab
entry.label: Show the Playing tab (the last remaining tab always stays)

entry.name: autoSwitchToPlaying
entry.label: A few seconds after a station starts playing, switch the popup to the Playing page — unless the listener is doing something in it

entry.name: rememberLastTab
entry.label: Open the widget on the tab it was left on

entry.name: lastTab
entry.label: The tab the widget was last left on

entry.name: showBitrateBadge
entry.label: Show the bitrate badge on the Playing page

entry.name: showCoverArt
entry.label: Show the cover on the Playing page

entry.name: showSearchRow
entry.label: Show the search field above the stations

entry.name: showDiscoveryRow
entry.label: Show the discovery row (Trending, the country list, the genre chips) above the stations

entry.name: showReorderHandles
entry.label: Show the drag handle and the remove button on each station row in the widget (Settings can always reorder and remove)

entry.name: compactRows
entry.label: Station rows at three-quarter height, smaller logos included — a long list without the scroll

entry.name: saveOnBattery
entry.label: Go easy on the battery when the laptop is unplugged

entry.name: recordMaxMinutes
entry.label: Hard cap for a single recording, in minutes (disk-fill protection)

entry.name: recordFormat
entry.label: Recording format: original (bit-exact copy, recommended), mp3 (re-encode), wav (uncompressed)

entry.name: recSchedules
entry.label: Scheduled recordings (JSON array)

entry.name: alarms
entry.label: Wake-up alarms (JSON array)

entry.name: schedTzOffset
entry.label: Last-seen timezone offset (minutes) for the schedulers; 9999 = unknown

entry.name: audioOutputDevice
entry.label: Audio output device id for local playback (empty = system default)
